_comment: Single source of truth for the sign-up prefill link. Edit here, then run `node scripts/render-signup-links.mjs --write` and `node scripts/check-signup-drift.mjs`. Never hand-edit the generated URLs in README.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, or AGENTS.md — check-signup-drift.mjs fails the build if they drift. See #69 for why: two variants of this body were live at once, and the one real testers actually hit was the unchecked one.
title: [signup]: tester registration
body: Replace this line with your public 0x wallet address.
Do not paste a private key, seed phrase, or any secret.
**This issue is your one-time registration and permanent reward tracker.** Leave the title as is — a bot renames it to your GitHub username.
### Your steps — tick each box as you finish it
- [ ] Replaced the placeholder above with my public 0x wallet, then pressed **Create**
- [ ] Completed the [0G Studio Survey](https://forms.gle/ymEdZrdTNs4giEm1A), entering my GitHub username **exactly as it appears as this issue's author**
- [ ] Completed the [0G Private Computer Survey](https://forms.gle/G919xrbRyfVJxPZe8), using that same GitHub username
### What the bot does — these arrive as labels and comments here, nothing for you to tick
| You'll see | What it means | When |
| a ✅ comment | wallet accepted — you're registered | within a minute |
| `signup:needs-fix` | wallet unreadable — edit this issue to fix it | within a minute |
| `l0:studio-done` / `l0:pc-done` | that survey reached us | minutes after you submit it |
| `l0:cleared` | both surveys in — **L0 done, 10 Credit** | once both have arrived |
Still nothing after a couple of days? The most common cause is a GitHub username in the survey that does not match this issue's author. Comment here and we'll sort it out.
After L0, file reproducible App Suite bugs with [Submit Feedback](https://github.com/0gfoundation/0g-testing-hub/issues/new?template=submit-feedback.yml) to climb toward **L1 (20 Credit)**.
